items.title: How to Turn $300,000 Into Passive Income: A 3-Stock Dividend Strategy
items.summary: A bear market can force retirees to sell shares at the worst possible moment. Three high-yield stocks, from a monthly-paying landlord to a telecom giant and a lender, offer a way to get paid without selling, but one of them has a coverage gap.

items.title: A $750,000 Dividend Portfolio Could Cost You $9,000 a Year in Taxes. Here’s How
items.summary: Two of the six stocks in this high-yield portfolio quietly drive most of the IRS bill, and a simple change in where you hold them could keep that money working for you. The compounding math over 20 years may surprise you.

items.title: A 71-Year-Old Gets $1200 A Month In Dividends From SCHD.  He Could Double His Investment Income By Swapping SCHD For Verizon. There’s Just One Problem
items.summary: Swapping one dividend holding for another could more than double a retiree's monthly checks. But a single bad board decision could erase that gain and chip away at his savings when he has the least time to recover.

items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks Paying Up to 6% With Payouts Built to Last
items.summary: A fat yield means nothing if the check bounces. Five payers across telecom, tobacco, pharma, real estate and pipelines show how to test coverage, and one of them carries a debt pile that could threaten its raise streak.
